status: ACTIVE - SEED list. Loaded by 04_A.I.Sending.ps1 (file name set in 01_Configuration.ps1: $AiModelsFileName). The agent keeps the real list up to date AUTOMATICALLY: it refreshes against Google's ListModels, removes models that disappear, and ADDS new models by itself after acceptance tests (see AGENT_RULES.md, Rule 15). Everything it learns at run time (adopted/removed/rejected models, aliases, weekly failure counts) lives in ai_model_state.json in the agent data folder, not in this file. You only edit this file to change a tier or to seed a model by hand.

howToRead.tier: 1 = normal. 2 = lower capability by definition (the -lite class); tier-2 models are tried only after all tier-1 models. Within a tier the order is decided by the failure rate of the last 7 days (Laplace-smoothed), then by the order of this file. The age or novelty of a model is never a reason to exclude it.
howToRead.api: generateContent = the endpoint the agent already uses (same request body for every entry). interactions = Interactions API (managed agents) - a different endpoint, NOT usable by the current code.
howToRead.quota: Google counts the free-tier daily request quota PER MODEL per project (seen in the real 429: GenerateRequestsPerDayPerProjectPerModel-FreeTier, limit 20) - every extra model in the list is an extra daily budget.

agentModels.role: Managed agent that plans, writes and runs code inside a Linux sandbox HOSTED BY GOOGLE.
agentModels.notes: It cannot reach or repair the local Windows machine (it works in Google's sandbox). Could be useful for analysis tasks, not for local fixes. Needs the Interactions API (not generateContent).

failoverOn: HTTP 429 for that model (its own quota) - the next model has its own quota
neverFailoverOn: HTTP 400 (our request is wrong - would fail on every model)
policy.weeklyStats: per model: ok / 503 (5xx, timeout, no answer) / 429 / 404 / other for each of the last 8 days (ai_model_state.json). 429 (key quota) is not counted as a model failure.
policy.autoRemove: a model missing from the Gemini ListModels answer on 2 consecutive daily syncs (at least 12 hours apart) is moved to 'removed'; a failed sync never removes anything; HTTP 404 on use counts as one confirmation
policy.newModels: Models that appear in ListModels are ADDED AUTOMATICALLY after passing: type filter (no audio/media/music/specialized), token limits + generateContent, a small real request (Greek text for reportModels; function calling for agentModels) and alias detection (a reply that names a different modelVersion means the model is only an alias and is not added). New models start with no history and never outrank a proven model.
policy.override: 01_Configuration.ps1: $AiModelOverride (empty = automatic). A non-empty id is always tried first.
